title: World App to World Money wallet lifecycle
notes: Stages the missing World wallet lineage from the 2023 World App public launch through the September 2026 World Money transition. The wallet/money-side identity is modeled as one continuing entity/product because first-party World material describes World Money as the dedicated money/wallet app after World identity and money functions were split. The 2026 event records the wallet-side rebrand/split boundary and does not claim that every former World App identity feature moved into World Money. Country-specific financial feature availability, stablecoin access, Earn/Morpho behavior, and payment rails are out of scope for this WLR bundle except as context.

entities.summary: Self-custodial mobile cryptocurrency wallet lineage launched publicly as World App in 2023 and continued as World Money in 2026 when World separated identity and money functions into dedicated apps.
entities.key_management_model: self-custodial wallet keys with Safe-based account-abstraction smart-contract accounts; optional encrypted cloud backup described by World
entities.notes: WLR preserves continuity between World App and the wallet/money-side World Money app. The 2026 split also created a dedicated World ID App for identity functions, so the alias does not imply that every historical World App function remains inside World Money.

products.key_management_model: self-custodial mobile wallet keys with Safe account abstraction
products.summary: World's mobile wallet application, publicly launched as World App and continued on the money/wallet side as World Money after the 2026 app split.
products.notes: Support status remains unknown because current availability alone is not a formal maintenance commitment under WLR policy.

events.title: World App Phase I launched globally
events.description: Tools for Humanity introduced Phase I of World App and made the mobile wallet globally available, describing self-custodial World ID and wallet keys and Safe-based account abstraction.
events.notes: The first-party launch article explicitly establishes the public Phase I launch date and wallet architecture.

events.title: World Money launches as the dedicated money and wallet app
events.description: World launched World Money while first-party support material documented a split of identity and money functions into World ID App and World Money. World Money retained the crypto wallet, WLD send/receive, payments, virtual-account and other finance functions.
events.notes: This is modeled as a wallet-lineage rebrand/split event. It does not assert that World Money is a simple rename of every historical World App function; identity functions are separately assigned to World ID App.

evidence.title: Introducing World App
evidence.notes: First-party launch article establishing Phase I public availability, iOS/Android distribution, self-custodial wallet keys and Safe account abstraction.

evidence.title: Introducing World App
evidence.notes: Used specifically for the self-custody and Safe account-abstraction architecture claims.

evidence.title: Introducing World Money: a financial super app for humans
evidence.notes: First-party World Money launch announcement establishing the September 17, 2026 launch and current money-app role.

evidence.title: What's the Difference between World ID App and World Money App?
evidence.notes: First-party support article establishing the identity/money app split and that World Money continues the crypto wallet, WLD send/receive and finance functions.

evidence.title: Glossary of Terms
evidence.notes: Current first-party glossary defines World Wallet as the wallet area in World Money and describes World Chain as infrastructure used for World Money wallet transactions.
